vocabulary.definition: a person skilled in a specific type of work or activity
vocabulary.example: The airplane technician fixed the engine before takeoff.

vocabulary.definition: a state of conflict, confusion, or instability
vocabulary.example: The passengers felt uneasy due to the turbulence during the flight.

vocabulary.definition: to follow or comply with (a rule, law, or custom)
vocabulary.example: Passengers must observe the safety regulations while on board.

vocabulary.definition: the process of working together to the same end
vocabulary.example: The crew and passengers showed great cooperation during the emergency landing.

vocabulary.definition: the quality of being intense; extreme force or strength
vocabulary.example: The intensity of the storm caused the flight to be delayed.

vocabulary.definition: a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress
vocabulary.example: After the turbulent flight, passengers felt relief when they landed safely.
